summary: Join our Gender Equality and Social Justice Training Course to gain essential skills and knowledge. Be a catalyst for change in your community!
lede: Gender equality training helps experienced professionals assess how policies and systems shape equity and inclusion, then plan practical changes. Participants learn to conduct intersectional equity audits, integrate gender considerations into projects and budgets, and identify bias in workplace policies and automated decision systems, supporting action planning and progress measurement.
audienceIntro: This program is designed for experienced professionals responsible for designing, implementing, or auditing social equity and inclusion strategies within their organizations.
modules: Foundations of GESI and Human Rights
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in human resources, policy development, social impact, or organizational management. A basic understanding of diversity and inclusion concepts is required; however, no prior technical knowledge of specific GESI frameworks is necessary as these will be taught in depth.
